preamble: Fronting of the voiced retroflex fricative [ʐ] to [z]. In Georgian, Proto-Kartvelian *z₁ became z, while Zan and Svan reflect it as ž: *mz₁e- 'sun' gives Old Georgian mzē beside Mingrelian bža and Svan miž. Wiktionary's subscript-1 series (*s₁, *z₁, *c₁, *ʒ₁) is the Gamkrelidze-Machavariani 'hissing-hushing' series, which the Wikipedia Proto-Kartvelian consonant table (after Gamkrelidze 1966 and Fähnrich 2002) gives as retroflex [ʂ ʐ ʈ͡ʂ ɖ͡ʐ]. Polish mazurzenie (ż > z) is filed under ʒ > z, since Koneczna and the description Wikipedia gives after Dejna, Kuraszkiewicz and Rospond derive the mazurating dentals directly from the older palato-alveolars.

examples.from: Proto-Kartvelian *mz₁e- 'sun' (Mingrelian ბჟა bža, Svan მიჟ miž)

examples.note: Georgian z continues the subscript-1 fricative, which Zan and Svan reflect as ž.
